question: Should generic tool-progress classification be a durable public Plugin SDK contract for external producers, or remain internal to bundled runtimes?
rationale: The PR adds two public symbols external plugins can depend on; source review and tests can validate behavior but cannot choose the permanent API boundary.

options.title: Keep the public generic marker
options.body: Accept TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload as the canonical external producer contract alongside the existing fast-mode progress marker.

options.title: Keep the marker internal
options.body: Remove the new public exports and retain generic tool-progress typing only behind bundled runtime seams.

recommendation.title: Keep the public generic marker
recommendation.body: Accept TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload as the canonical external producer contract alongside the existing fast-mode progress marker.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the adjacent public progress marker and has recent history across both the reply-payload and Slack delivery boundaries.
